title: Qualify disk-space documentation by launcher mode
outcome: docs/test.md accurately distinguishes root/artifact checks in every mode from Cargo-output checks performed only for full/live requests with needsCargo.
acceptance: The disk-space section states that automatic Cargo-output filesystem selection is limited to full/live modes.
Focused Cargo commands and category runs are documented as requiring separate coordinator output-volume planning.
The documented 100 GiB warning and full-only 50 GiB/unknown-capacity refusal remain unchanged.
